frames.narration: Configuration says logging is on. The service is given a real ConsoleLogger.
place(1) calls logger.log(...) with no check. The real logger prints a line.
Another setup has logging off. The same service is given a NullLogger instead.
place(1) runs the exact same code. The call goes to the NullLogger, which does nothing.
There is no if anywhere in OrderService, so there is no check to forget. The decision was made once, in the configuration.
